description: Every position an ETF holds, from its latest SEC Form N-PORT filing (not Yahoo). Returns the top positions by weight plus concentration: how many holdings make up half the fund, top-10 and top-25 weight, effective number of holdings, and breakdowns by asset type and country. Data is quarterly and about 60 days behind. Needs SEC_USER_AGENT set to a name and email.

top.description: How many positions to list, 1-100. Default 25.

name: get_etf_full_holdings
